items.name: Crossbow
items.description: This ranged weapon has a bow-like assembly mounted on a handled frame called a tiller. The tiller has a mechanism to lock the bowstring in place, attached to a trigger mechanism that releases the tension and launches a bolt.

items.name: Longsword
items.description: Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 feet in length.

items.name: Hatchet
items.description: This small axe can be used in close combat or thrown.

items.name: Breastplate
items.description: Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Half Plate] armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

items.name: Key Ring
items.description: Contains keys to all locks in Drelev Keep

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Defensive Slice
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirement Baron Drelev hasn't attempted a Strike during this turn.

Effect Baron Drelev assumes a defensive position with his weapons out, then attempts a melee Strike. He takes a -2 status penalty on all Strikes (including this one) and gains a +2 status bonus to his AC until the start of his next turn.

Effect: Defensive Slice

offensiveAbilities.name: Dramatic Disarm
offensiveAbilities.description: If Baron Drelev scores a critical success on an Athletics check to Disarm an opponent, he can choose to have the disarmed item fly 1d4 × 5 feet in a random direction rather than have it fall to the ground in the opponent's space. If this causes the item to land in a space occupied by a creature with at least one free hand, that creature can attempt a DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save to catch the item (otherwise it falls to the ground in that space).

offensiveAbilities.name: Harrying Swordfighter
offensiveAbilities.description: Baron Drelev adds the disarm weapon trait to any sword he wields.

offensiveAbilities.name: Skirmish Strike
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per turn

Effect Baron Drelev Steps and then Strikes or Strikes and then Steps.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Baron Drelev deals 2d6 extra precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.
